WITH _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier AS (
  SELECT
    `_stage_inner`.`customers___plan_code` AS `plan_code`,
    `_stage_inner`.`customers___tier` AS `tier`,
    `_stage_inner`.`customers___spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier` AS `spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      customers.plan_code AS `customers___plan_code`,
      customers.tier AS `customers___tier`,
      CAST(SUM(customers.spend) AS FLOAT64) AS `customers___spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier`
    FROM customers AS customers
    LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
      ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
    WHERE
      orders.status = 'ok'
    GROUP BY
      customers.plan_code,
      customers.tier
  ) AS _stage_inner
), _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier AS (
  SELECT
    _stage_inner.`customers___tier` AS `tier`,
    _stage_inner.`customers___avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier` AS `avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier`
  FROM (
    SELECT
      `_base`.`customers___tier` AS `customers___tier`,
      CAST(AVG(_base._v) AS FLOAT64) AS `customers___avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier`
    FROM (
      SELECT
        customers.tier AS `customers___tier`,
        customers.plan_code AS _ek0,
        customers.tier AS _ek1,
        MAX(
          _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.`spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier`
        ) AS _v
      FROM customers AS customers
      LEFT JOIN orders AS orders
        ON customers.id = orders.customer_id
      LEFT JOIN _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier
        ON customers.plan_code IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.`plan_code`
        AND customers.tier IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.`tier`
      WHERE
        orders.status = 'ok'
      GROUP BY
        customers.tier,
        customers.plan_code,
        customers.tier
    ) AS _base
    GROUP BY
      `_base`.`customers___tier`
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers.tier AS `customers___tier`,
  SUM(
    customers.spend * _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.`avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier`
  ) AS `customers___m`
FROM customers AS customers
LEFT JOIN _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier
  ON customers.tier IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.`tier`
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM orders AS orders
    WHERE
      customers.id = orders.customer_id AND orders.status = 'ok'
  )
GROUP BY
  customers.tier

            AND _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.[plan_code] IS NULL
          )
        )
        AND (
          customers.tier = _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.[tier]
          OR (
            customers.tier IS NULL
            AND _cm_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.[tier] IS NULL
          )
        )
      WHERE
        orders.status = 'ok'
      GROUP BY
        customers.tier,
        customers.plan_code,
        customers.tier
    ) AS _base
    GROUP BY
      _base.[customers___tier]
  ) AS _stage_inner
)
SELECT
  customers.tier AS [customers___tier],
  SUM(
    customers.spend * _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.[avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier]
  ) AS [customers___m]
FROM customers AS customers
LEFT JOIN _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier
  ON (
    customers.tier = _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.[tier]
    OR (
      customers.tier IS NULL
      AND _cm_avg_spend_sum_partition_by_plan_code_tier.[tier] IS NULL
    )
  )
WHERE
  EXISTS(
    SELECT
      1
    FROM orders AS orders
    WHERE
      customers.id = orders.customer_id AND orders.status = 'ok'
  )
GROUP BY
  customers.tier
